ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( AND( PRIORVALUE(Exclude_Admin_Fee__c) <> Exclude_Admin_Fee__c, Current_Step_Name__c <> "CRM Request Verification" ),
AND(Exclude_Admin_Fee__c, ISBLANK(Exclude_Admin_Fee_Reason__c)), AND(NOT(Exclude_Admin_Fee__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Exclude_Admin_Fee_Reason__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Exclude Admin Fee is true, Exclude Admin Fee Reason cannot be blank (and vice versa).
